title: The Impact of Voluntary Carbon Goal Announcements on Stock Returns
authors: Lukas Schnabel; Setareh Heidari; Stefan J. Hock; Sascha Raithel
main_or_robustness: main (short-window stock-return event study and cross-sectional CAR regressions)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: financial event study of cumulative abnormal returns for 188 announcements; no unit and calendar-time FE panel
cross-sectional OLS of CAR on announcement characteristics with time-varying controls and industry dummies; not DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. The paper is a short-window financial event study: CARs around 188 voluntary carbon-goal announcements, then cross-sectional OLS of CARs on announcement and media characteristics.
design_notes: Stata Main Analyses.do: reg CARm2p2 focalvar controls industry, rob. Eventus/CRSP abnormal returns.
data_files_note: dataset.xlsx (188 x 194) ships only hand-coded announcement variables; abnormal returns (ARm10..ARp10), PERMNO, financial controls, ESG and emissions columns are empty (commercial data withheld).
data_provenance_note: Outcome (abnormal returns) and controls withheld as commercial data.
screener_notes: Published text confirms CAR event-study design. Not a near miss.
